product.title: Niagara Falls in One Day from New York City
product.description: Visit Niagara Falls on a full-day guided trip from New York City with roundtrip transportation, scenic viewpoints, and free time to explore one of North America's most iconic natural attractions.
highlights: Travel from New York City to Niagara Falls and back in one day
Enjoy guided commentary and coordinated logistics
See major viewpoints and capture classic Niagara photos

start.description: Meeting point in Midtown Manhattan. Exact departure details are provided after booking.

product.itinerarySummary: Depart New York City early and travel north to Niagara Falls with your guide. Spend time at key viewing areas and enjoy free time before returning to Manhattan in the evening.

faq.question: Is this a roundtrip day trip from New York City?
faq.answer: Yes, this experience includes same-day roundtrip transportation from New York City.
